assumptions: Workbook values are organizer-supplied synthetic planning limits, not actual airport data.
One runway and two candidate spare gates are a declared subset of the airport inventory. Other gates are unavailable to this decision.
Background movements are a complete synthetic traffic schedule within the planning and capacity windows; filtered DOT rows are not a queue.
M denotes Large; S/H/L denote Super/Heavy/Small. Same-runway departure time minima are an explicitly declared arrival simulation proxy; nautical-mile separation is not modeled.
Narrowbody class, 4000 kg trip fuel, 20 kg/min taxi burn and 50 kg uncertainty allowance are synthetic inputs. Arrival spare fuel includes the reserve and contingency, a conservative interpretation.
Flight duty ends at gate arrival. Report time and ground crew report times are synthetic; ground maximum duty ends at t=7200, an additional declared scenario cap.
Gate-change notice is measured from t=0 to landing, conservatively before gate arrival. Routes, service targets, connections, reservations and equipment availability are synthetic.

facts.units: seconds, kg/hour, percent, count, nautical miles

facts.source_reference: scenario fuel reserve and uncertainty policy

ATC.rationale: Initial preference L1200-G2-route passes all ATC checks with maximum separation margin. Offering L1260-G1-long and L1260-G2-route as concessions maintains safe separation (margin ≥120s) while providing flexibility for ground operations. Delayed options (L1320+, L1380, L1560) reduce separation margins to 0-60s, increasing ATC risk without clear benefit.

GROUND.rationale: L1260-G1-long is the assigned gate with zero ground cost, minimum turnaround, and compliant crew/equipment. Concessions defer landing to relieve runway pressure, keeping service windows and GPU-1 valid per checks and policy limits.

PILOT.rationale: L1200-G2-route is preferred for 190 kg reserve margin. L1260-G2-route and L1260-G1-long are offered as early landing compromises with adequate fuel margins, while later candidates risk marginal reserves.

ATC.rationale: L1260-G1-long is a valid concession within ATC's allowed budget. Runway, separation (120s margin), and capacity checks all pass, ensuring safe operations while meeting ground and pilot preferences.

GROUND.rationale: Proposal aligns with initial preference L1260-G1-long. All ground checks pass, domain cost is zero, and gate occupancy matches the assigned reservation without conflict.

PILOT.rationale: Proposal is in the offered concession set. Fuel and duty checks pass, but no CREW-G1 availability evidence is provided for CREW-G1. Duty evidence exists only for the initial CREW-G2 candidate.
